{{E|Ancient Writing}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 2]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Elegance}} {{TS|positive||Remove a card from your deck.}}
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Simplicity}} {{TS|positive||[[Upgrade]] all Strikes and Defends.}}
* Only includes {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Basic|Basic}} cards.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Scaling the city, you notice a wall covered in the writing of {{TS|gold|up|Ancients.}} As you try to wrap your head around what the puzzling symbols and glyphs could mean, the writing begins to {{TS|blue|up|glow.}}<br>
Suddenly, the message becomes clear...
</div>
<br><br>
{{Frame|Elegance}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The answer was elegance.<br>
Of course.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Simplicity}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
The truth is always simple.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* The internal name of this event is <code>Back_to_Basics</code>.

== Update History ==
* '''Weekly Patch 50: The Final Act'''
** Fixed softlock caused if you can't remove cards in: Back to Basics, Cleric, and Living Wall events.
* '''Weekly Patch 17: Patched in the Face'''
** Ascender's Bane can no longer be removed by Back to Basics event.
